Triage: `needs-user-decision`(契约形状之争 —— 两个方向都动 `@objectstack/spec` 公开面,人工地板),type Bug。决策分析(中文,按标准块):

**一句话问题**:列表视图工具栏的三个真实能力(分组 / 列显隐 / 行着色)在规范里写不出来,而运行时的兼容折叠还会自己造出这三个被规范点名拒收的键 —— 折叠的输出过不了它自己的保存门。

**选项 × 真实代价**:

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知代价 |
|---|---|---|
| A | 规范收编:`UserActionsConfigSchema` 增加 `group` / `hideFields` / `rowColor` 三键(declared = enforced) | 公开契约 +3 键的永久维护义务;换来作者(含 AI)能声明三个今天已真实存在的开关 |
| B | 退役:折叠不再产出三键,渲染器摘除三个开关(ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) | 三个真实工具栏能力从产品消失;存量用旧 `show*` 标志的视图行为可感知变化(分组按钮不见了) |
| C | 折叠止血:只产出规范认可的键,丢弃三个 legacy 标志并告警;渲染器保留对旧 `show*` 的直读 | 两套拼写继续共存 —— 恰是折叠存在要退役的状态,永久延续 |

**业务直译**:A = 把已经卖给用户的功能补进说明书;B = 把说明书之外的功能下架;C = 说明书和实际各说各话再拖一版。

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
长远:A 收敛「声明即强制」;B 收敛面但以砍活能力为代价;C 延续双拼写,是三者中最差的长期形态。
业务:分组/列显隐/行着色是列表产品的常规预期能力,今天用户经 legacy 标志真实可用 —— 只是无法用规范拼写声明;砍掉(B)是用户可感知的倒退。
防AI错:现状最危险 —— 运行时自己产出会被保存门按名拒收的文档(实测三键各 1 issue,control 键通过);A 后 declared=enforced 闭合;B 则需全仓清扫防 AI 从旧例复制。
创业:+3 键是小扩面,但对应**已实现、渲染器已尊重**的真实能力,不是投机声明面;B 是净删除但删的是活功能。

**推荐**:A;回退 B。**置信缺口(本分析看不见什么)**:存量 app/模板里 `show*` 三标志的真实使用量未测;Studio 视图设计器是否已为这三个开关提供授权 UI 未测 —— 若两者皆零,B 的代价大幅缩小。
回一个字母即可;「A,但只收 group」= 按键裁剪的 A。

**裁后执行(你不用管)**:A ⇒ objectstack spec 车道立契约卡(条款②,契约复审档),objectui 折叠/渲染测试随 pin 对齐;B ⇒ objectui 退役卡 + legacy 清扫;C 不建议,不派。

The full decision inbox (46 cards) was presented with per-card four-axis recommendations; the maintainer accepted the batch, verbatim: 「接受所有」.

**Ruled:** Option A — the spec adopts the three keys. `UserActionsConfigSchema` gains `group`, `hideFields`, and `rowColor`, so the three toolbar affordances `ListView` already honours become authorable in a spec-valid document and the fold's output passes the save gate (declared = enforced closes). Per the triage execution note, this routes as an objectstack spec-lane contract card (clause ②, contract-review tier), with objectui's fold/renderer tests aligning on the pin. Option B (retiring three live product capabilities) and Option C (permanent double-spelling) are not taken.

State: `needs-user-decision` removed → `pm:queue` (ready for dispatch).

The defect is self-contained and squarely in this repo's own north star: **the runtime fold manufactures three keys (`userActions.group`, `hideFields`, `rowColor`) that `ListViewSchema` refuses BY NAME**, so `normalizeListViewSchema`'s own output cannot pass the view save gate. A producer emitting what the contract rejects is the shape this project treats as a first-class defect, not a nit.

⚠️ **Not re-verified against current `main`** (card dated 2026-08-20). Re-measure on pickup — including whether the spec has since adopted any of the three keys, which would change the fix from "stop manufacturing" to "the schema was behind".

## Protocol sweep — ✅ DECIDED, and the ADR-0049 limb is REFUSED

PM seat (`domain:spec` @ objectui, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`), 2026-09-10. Read-only sweep against the maintainer principle now in force:

> 我们的项目以 objectstack 协议为准，文档应该以实际实现为准。协议不正确的应该先修改协议。

(source: objectui#8934 [`5617613810`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/8934#issuecomment-5617613810).)

### ⭐ The protocol already moved to objectui — not the reverse

Measured at objectstack `eabdd66f45f402eba0f8404a8a9de4a501fc83a6`, spec **17.3.0** (this card was filed against **17.0.0**):

```
ui/view.zod.ts:1045   group: z.boolean().default(true).describe('Allow users to change record grouping from the toolbar. Toggle only — the group…
ui/view.zod.ts:1048   hideFields: …
ui/view.zod.ts:1049   rowColor: …
```

and the docblock above them, at **`ui/view.zod.ts:1018`**, **names this card by number**: *"adopted from objectui's legacy `show*` fold … **ruled Option A on objectui#5435**"*. The ON/OFF default asymmetry is copied from the renderer's own reads.

⇒ The three keys `normalizeListViewSchema` manufactures — `userActions.group` / `hideFields` / `rowColor` — are **declared in the protocol**, on `UserActionsConfigSchema`. The fold's output is no longer inventing keys the contract refuses; the contract caught up.

### ⛔ What this refuses

This card's **ADR-0049 "retire the three toggles" limb is refused.** Tombstoning them in objectui would now make objectui **narrower than the protocol** — the one direction the principle forbids. If they should go, that is an **objectstack spec card first**.

### What is left

**Verification and a pin.** The residual work is to confirm on `origin/main` that `ListViewSchema` no longer refuses the three by name, and to pin the fold's output against the declaration so this cannot silently regress — ⛔ with a firing control, since the whole defect was that nothing ever asserted the fold's output was authorable.

⚠️ **The card is stale as filed** (measured against spec 17.0.0). Re-derive its line anchors and its "refuses BY NAME" claim on your own base before writing anything; ⛔ do not inherit them.

### ⚠️ What the sweep did NOT measure

- **No parse.** Zero `safeParse` probes. "The three keys are declared" is a **source** reading of the protocol's zod; *"`ListViewSchema.safeParse` accepts them"* is an inference from it, ⛔ not a measurement. **The dispatched dev owes the executed version.**
- **objectui's resolved `@objectstack/spec` version.** Only declared ranges were read from `package.json` (`^17.0.0` root, `^17.2.0` in `core` / `data-objectstack`) — ⛔ no `node_modules`, no lockfile. **If objectui actually resolves an older 17.x, this verdict is right about the protocol and premature about objectui's behaviour.** Measure the resolved version first.
- objectui's own side (`normalize-list-view.ts`, `ListView.tsx`) was **relayed from this card's body, not measured**.

This card's objectui-side reads were **not** taken from the stale branch that contaminated four of the sweep's other cards — its verdict rests on the protocol, read read-only at a pinned hash.

## Landing — verification delivered, and the dispatch was wrong twice

PM seat (`domain:spec` @ objectui, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`), 2026-09-10. PR **#8987**, head `08d9c478fe96`.

### The two owed measurements, both delivered

**① Resolved spec version — the one that could have voided the verdict.** The sweep read only declared ranges and said so. Measured on the installed artifact: objectui resolves **`@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`** — one resolution in `pnpm-lock.yaml`, used by all 29 importers, one physical package on disk. That is **newer** than the 17.3.0 the dispatch expected, ⇒ the protocol verdict is **not premature** for objectui's behaviour. Had it resolved 17.2.x, this card's answer would have changed.

**② Executed parse — ⛔ not the source reading the sweep offered.** `ListViewSchema.safeParse` accepts `userActions.group` / `hideFields` / `rowColor`, **0 issues each**, and accepts the real seven-toggle `userActions` block `normalizeListViewSchema` emits. **Two firing controls redden** with exactly 1 `unrecognized_keys` issue apiece — so the greens are measurements, ⛔ not a vacuous pass.

⇒ delivered verification + a pin + a graded changeset. **The three toggles were NOT retired**, per the refused limb.

### ⛔ Two dispatch claims the dev falsified
